fact: The new civil registration system launched by MINALOC and the National Identification Agency has interoperable capabilities linking the national CRVS to the National Population Registry and the Health Information Management System.
NIDA's director general says the new digital ID system is integrated with Rwanda's civil registration and vital statistics system, without saying which records pass.
